transform_search_request: transform a search query and optional parameters into Brave Search API request format
transform_search_response: transform a Brave Search API HTTP response into a unified SearchResponse object
validate_environment: validate the Brave API key and return configured HTTP headers for authenticated requests
get_complete_url: build a complete Brave Search API URL with query parameters from transformed request data
to_yyyy_mm_dd: convert a string, integer, or float date representation to a YYYY-MM-DD formatted string
